fact: The ACHPR promotion mission of 10-14 March 2025 was told Seychelles has not domesticated the Refugee Convention, leaving asylum seekers without a legal framework or structured asylum system, and it urged a national asylum framework.
title: Rapport de la mission de promotion en république des Seychelles 10 – 14 Mars 2025
publisher: Commission africaine des droits de l'homme et des peuples
